name: microservicios-backend
description: Backend con microservicios en Node.js (Inventarios, Órdenes, Gateway)

scripts.stop: docker-compose down && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down && docker-compose -f docker-compose.hybrid-dev.yml down && docker-compose -f docker-compose.staging.yml down
scripts.clean: docker-compose down -v && docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && docker-compose -f docker-compose.hybrid-dev.yml down -v && docker-compose -f docker-compose.staging.yml down -v && docker system prune -f
scripts.build:all: npm run build:gateway && npm run build:inventarios && npm run build:ordenes
scripts.deploy:hybrid: npm run build:all && npm run dev:hybrid:detached
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:all && npm run staging:detached
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:all && npm run prod:detached

author: Your Name
